# Flightline 0.1.4
- Customize keyboard shortcuts with a full keyboard layout, command search, presets, and conflict detection. Add flight points, apply edits, mark clips ready for export, and switch viewer modes from the keyboard. - Tracers become thinner with distance while respecting the Width setting, in both preview and export. - Switch projects while clips process, remove waiting clips from the queue, and mark clips Ready for Export from the queue context menu. - Applied flight edits refresh correctly instead of leaving a stale draft warning. - Camera repair keeps the selected frame when using Correct here, provides a separate Jump to tracking stop control, and explains failed or short tracking with exact frame numbers and match counts. - Older flight drafts are clearly identified before further camera repair.
Existing media and saved solves are retained. Keyboard preferences are saved per operator in the current browser or app.

# Flightline 0.1.3
- Mark reviewed clips ready to export from the Review tab, with a green queue highlight and a saved status that can be undone. Flight and tracer style changes clear readiness. - Multi-shot ingest and source-window review improvements. - Camera repair and solver reliability updates, with opt-in experimental camera reconstruction tools.
Existing footage and saved solves are retained. Analyze again to apply new analysis to an existing clip. Experimental reconstruction tools are not automatically applied to saved shots.

# Flightline 0.1.2
- Export Locally or Export to Client without an approval-and-lock step. Client exports save to May Server; local exports have a 24-hour download window. - Dynamic allocation of the four workers between processing and active operator projects. - Exclusive project terminals with an explicit message identifying the operator already editing. - More responsive drawing, frame stepping, and scrubbing, plus Native frame and Render check views. - Targeted 3D camera recovery and tracer hold/fade coverage checks. Difficult lateral-motion shots can still require ground registration; this release does not eliminate drift on all footage.
Existing footage and saved solves are preserved. Use Analyze again to apply the new camera analysis to an existing shot.

# Flightline 0.1.1
- Check for new releases with Flightline → Check for Updates. - Choose automatic update checks and automatic installation in Flightline → Settings. - Updates are signed and verified before installation.
This first updater-enabled release must be installed manually over 0.1.0. Future releases can be installed from inside Flightline.
